plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Script-free skills for the software development lifecycle: each one a terse description of one process, done the way we want it done. Portable to any harness and any repo; sdlc links them in and adds the deterministic tail.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Lightweight SDLC workflow: capture backlog items, capabilities, decisions, drivers, milestones, principles, products, references, standards, tasks, and terms as markdown files with validated frontmatter. Ships task-level skills (task-work, task-review, task-ensure-ready, task-define) plus a JSON-schema-driven frontmatter validator every entity type plugs into.
